<description>
**Problem:** An interrupted `loadtxoutset` can leave an incomplete `chainstate_snapshot` database without its required `base_blockhash` marker. A later call can fail to open that database, requiring the operator to remove it manually before retrying.

**Fix:** Wipe the snapshot database before opening it so a later call can replace incomplete data. LevelDB acquires the database lock before deleting files, so a database held open by another load cannot be wiped. Also correct the startup warning to identify the missing marker and explain that retrying replaces the directory.
</description>

<commits>
00b1aa6116 test: characterize incomplete snapshot database retry

Record that an incomplete snapshot database prevents loadtxoutset until the operator removes its directory.

15a891d402 validation: replace incomplete snapshot databases when loading

An interrupted snapshot load can leave a database without its base-block marker, preventing later loadtxoutset attempts.
Wipe the snapshot database before opening it so callers can retry without removing the directory manually.
Correct the startup warning to point at the missing marker and say that a retry replaces the directory.
</commits>
